name: Safety Playground: NR33 Confined Space
summary:
Safety Playground: NR33 Confined Space is a virtual reality training simulation designed to support safety awareness and procedural learning for confined space work.

The experience places the user in an immersive industrial scenario where they can review key safety concepts, identify risks, follow guided procedures and interact with training elements related to confined space activities.
